Quiet Heron loader analysis

Quiet Heron is delivered as an ISO containing a LNK file that runs cmd.exe /c start /min powershell -nop -w hidden -enc SQBFAFgA.

The loader drops C:\ProgramData\heron\svc.dll and registers it with regsvr32 /s.

It installs a service named HeronUpdate with sc.exe create HeronUpdate binPath= C:\ProgramData\heron\svc.exe start= auto. The remaining text pads this synthetic article so that it is comfortably above the minimum content length that the junk filter applies, similar to a full research post that the RSS feed only teased in its description element.
